reviewNotes: Imported from CCEH tune 001292 (the melody read from 001292a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Charles Francois Gounod's dates (1818–1893) are from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charles_Gounod (17 June 1818 - 18 October 1893); CCEH's page gives only the year 1872. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001292a.nwc).
